Welcome
to Liberia
About Libassa
​
Libassa Ecolodge is a family owned business, which started from the dream to enjoy Liberia's wild and beautiful nature in an ecofriendly way.
​
We are located within an original tropical forest, at the junction of a virgin lagoon and the Atlantic ocean, only 30 minutes from Robert's International Airport and Monrovia. Our entire resort is eco friendly, built in harmony with the natural environment, in search of the right balance between human intervention and nature's wonderful architecture.
Your journey for a day, your home for a night, you will enjoy our forests, beach, lagoon, pools, our botanical gardens and our indeginous wildlife.

Rooms & Suites | Libassa Ecolodge
top of page
Rooms & Suites...
Our resort offers 20 rooms and suites, built with natural local materials, in harmony with nature. Their design is inspired by local traditional houses used by natives for generations. The thatch roofs and lodge layout within the forest keeps things cool even in the hottest hours of the day. Hot showers, ceiling and floor fans and electricity are provided in each room. Internet and breakfast included. We are deeply committed to sustainable eco-tourism, and keeping our impact on the environment to a minimum. You will enjoy a unique experience close to nature at Libassa Ecolodge.
Check Availability
Note: we are located in a remote location where sometimes credit card POS does not work. Also cards without PIN are not accepted in Liberia. Therefore please come prepared.

Benefits of visiting Our eco-friendly paradise
top of page
Search
‎
‎ Libassa Ecologe  caters to nature enthusiasts, adventure seekers, and those seeking relaxation in an eco-conscious environment. Here’s a detailed overview of its advantages:
‎ A.  Immersive Nature Experience -
The lodge is nestled in a pristine tropical forest near a lagoon and the ocean, allowing visitors to connect deeply with nature. Activities like bird watching, hiking through scenic trails, and exploring the Libassa Wildlife Sanctuary provide opportunities to observe Liberia’s rich biodiversity .
‎ B. Eco-Friendly Stay -
Libassa Ecolodge operates sustainably, prioritizing eco-friendly practices. Its design and operations minimize environmental impact, making it an ideal choice for travelers conscious of their ecological footprint .
‎C. Diverse Recreational Activities -
‎Guests can enjoy water-based adventures such as kayaking, paddle boating, and lazy river rides, as well as relaxing on the beach. The resort also features a waterslide and five outdoor pools, blending excitement with leisure .
‎ D. Cultural and Community Connection -
The lodge promotes cultural immersion by encouraging interactions with local communities. This enriches visitors’ understanding of Liberian traditions and lifestyles .
‎ E. Relaxation and Wellness Amenities -
‎ Complimentary breakfast buffets, beach side massages, and spa services ensure a rejuvenating stay. These amenities cater to travelers looking to unwind in a tranquil setting .
